description: Texts a client or teammate on your person's order, from the business number, as a Manual send under the business's Sending setting. Use it whenever your person asks you to text someone now, with their words or words you wrote for them ("text today's cleaners about the weather"); create_draft leaves it for someone else to send later. First call without confirm_token: nothing is sent; you get a preview (who it goes to and the exact text) and a confirm_token. Show your person the preview word for word, and only after they say yes, call again with the same arguments and the SAME idempotency_key, plus confirm_token. Several people: one preview each, shown together, one yes covers the ones they approve. Never send something nobody asked for, or while nobody is watching; that is a draft (create_draft). Give conversationId (one-to-one: to defaults to the conversation's number); for a cleaner or contact without one, read clients (contact_type 'staff' for cleaners) for the phone, then open_conversation_by_phone.

confirm_token.description: From the preview, after your person said yes. Leave it out to get the preview.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: send_text
title: Send a text (after your person confirms)
